name: dsh-observe
description: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse observability exporter for DeepSeek Harness: turn/step/tool/LLM spans, token and cost metrics, and sanitized LLM prompt/completion capture from the session/event stream, with async batching, bounded offline buffering, and retry
readme:
<div align="center">

# 📊 dsh-observe

**DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenTelemetry 与 Langfuse 可观测性导出器。**

*把会话事件变成 OTLP 追踪与 Langfuse 观测 —— 脱敏、缓冲、默认关闭。*
